scene_description: Four children are sitting around a campfire in the woods. They are roasting marshmallows on sticks over a fire pit. A tent is visible in the background, and the children are seated in camp chairs on a dirt ground surrounded by trees.

questions.question: What do you see in the middle of the picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round pit in the center of the picture with orange flames.

questions.question: What are the kids doing with their sticks?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the children are holding and where the sticks are pointing.

questions.question: Where are the kids sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the trees, dirt ground, and tent in the background.

questions.question: What is the big green thing in the background?
questions.evidence_hint: Look behind the children on the right side of the picture.

questions.question: What might the kids do with the marshmallows after they are done roasting them?
questions.evidence_hint: Think about what people do with food after they cook it.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been camping or sat around a fire?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you were outside at night or on a trip.
